applicableAreas: Mid-left portion of site plan near Building 2
findings.comment: Incomplete detail reference located on Sheet 9 states 'Tree Well need to look up approp. detail' with no complete detail specification provided. Additionally, two sidewalk easement callouts on the same sheet are missing document numbers (Doc# left blank). All detail references must be complete and clearly identify the applicable detail sheet and detail number.

applicableAreas: Parking lot and parking structure areas
findings.comment: Site is subject to Compatibility Standards (MF-2 zoning within 75 feet of adjacent SF-3 parcel). The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9 addresses general lighting shielding per Subchapter E 2.5 but does not specifically address vehicle light screening from parking lots/structures. Under LDC § 25-2-1063(E)(1), vehicle lights from vehicles using or parked on a parking lot or in a parking structure must be screened from the property line or alleyway shared with the triggering property. This requirement must be demonstrated on the site plan with specific shielding details or clarifying notes.

codeCitations: General Site Plan Notes for COA
findings.comment: The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9, Block 1 states 'All exterior lighting will be full cut-off and fully shielded in compliance with Subchapter E 2.5...' but does not specify that it applies only to new or proposed exterior lighting, not to existing fixtures. The note must clarify scope to avoid confusion with any existing site fixtures.

codeCitations: General Site Plan Notes for COA
findings.comment: The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9, Block 1 does not specify that the requirement applies within the limits of construction or project-specific boundaries. The note must include clarifying language such as 'within the limits of construction' or 'for all new exterior lighting within the project site' to establish clear scope.
